messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Art. 11(2)

Article 11 Safeguard clause. 2. The Member State shall immediately inform the Commission and the other Member States of any such measure, indicating the reasons for its decision and, in particular, whether the non-conformity is due to: (a) failure to satisfy the essential requirements referred to in Article 5(1)(a); (b) incorrect application of the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2); (c) shortcomings in the harmonised standards themselves referred to in Article 7(2).

response.text:
Member State | mustInform | Commission and other Member States | when it takes a safeguard measure | The Member State shall immediately inform the Commission and the other Member States of any such measure
Member State's notification | indicatesReasons | reasons for its decision | when it takes a safeguard measure | indicating the reasons for its decision
Member State's notification | statesCauseOfNonConformity | whether the non-conformity is due to one of the listed causes | when it takes a safeguard measure | in particular, whether the non-conformity is due to:
non-conformity | mayBeDueTo | failure to satisfy the essential requirements in Article 5(1)(a) | when it takes a safeguard measure | (a) failure to satisfy the essential requirements referred to in Article 5(1)(a)
non-conformity | mayBeDueTo | incorrect application of the harmonised standards in Article 7(2) | when it takes a safeguard measure | (b) incorrect application of the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2)
non-conformity | mayBeDueTo | shortcomings in the harmonised standards themselves in Article 7(2) | when it takes a safeguard measure | (c) shortcomings in the harmonised standards themselves referred to in Article 7(2)
